meta.name: mass-ulw
meta.description: Drives dependency-ordered child work through the native workflow tool, one run per phase with retry/amend/send recovery. Use when the user asks for mass-ulw, a DAG of tasks, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按依赖顺序分阶段推进多步骤任务,出错可重试或修改后继续。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常需要让多个互有先后依赖的任务按序自动推进。
copy.tagline_en: Run dependent subtasks in phases, with retry and repair on failure.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to push groups of ordered tasks automatically.

howto.what: 它把有先后依赖的多步任务拆成节点图,按依赖分批并行派出子代理执行;某个节点失败可单独重试或改写指令,已完成的结果会被复用,节点和运行声称完成前须用证据核验。
howto.when: 当你说出 “mass-ulw”,或给出的并行多代理任务里存在依赖关系(例如任务 C 需等 A、B 完成)时触发。

say.text: 用 mass-ulw 把这次任务拆成有依赖的节点图并跑起来
say.note: 先在 eval 单元里定义 DAG 再启动运行

say.text: 重跑刚才失败的节点,并把它的指令改成跳过 vendor 目录
say.note: 只重试该节点及受影响的下游节点

say.text: 取消这次运行,原因是被新计划取代了
say.note: 运行停止并在记录中写明取消原因

howto.what_en: It turns a multi-step job with real dependencies into a node graph, dispatches child agents in parallel waves as dependencies clear, and lets you retry or re-prompt one failed node while reusing finished results.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for mass-ulw, give a task DAG, or request fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others.

say_en.text: Use mass-ulw to split this job into a dependency graph and run it
say_en.note: It defines the DAG in an eval cell, then starts the run

say_en.text: Retry the failed node and edit its prompt to skip the vendored dir
say_en.note: Only that node and its dependents re-run

say_en.text: Cancel this run, reason: superseded by a new plan
say_en.note: The run stops and records the reason
